outline: 課程主要為介紹機器學習概念和基本原理，學習DNN/CNN/LSTM/transformer的神經網路架構和其他機器學習方法。
schedule:
1. Introduction with computer tool
2. DNN with labs and case study radio resource allocation (optional)
3. Learning method with labs(AI玩遊戲)
4. CNN with labs(AI影像分類/物件偵測)
5. RNN LSTM (AI聊天機器人/翻譯)with lab and case study 5G polar code decoding (optional)
6. Analogizers: K-means, kNN, SVM
7. transformer (AI寫金庸小說/寫學習歷程檔案) with case study scene boundary detection (AI影片分章)
8. Naïve Bayes classifier (Baysian statistics optional) (AI判斷貸款會違約嗎)
9. Symbolists: Decision Tree (AI判斷貸款會違約嗎)
10. Autodecoder (AI影像去雜訊/著色) / neural style transfer with labs
11. Deep Reinforcement Learning (AlphaGo下圍棋勝世界冠軍，OpenAI Five玩Dota 2勝世界冠軍)
scorePolicy:
口頭報告 20%
考試 25%
Lab report 25% (一組口頭報告1 lab)
Project 30%
